title: Apollo Lodge and RV Park - Fairfield TX

services.name: RV Site Rates
services.desc: Everything you need for a comfortable stay - nothing inflated with franchise fees. Whether you're in one of our hotel rooms or one of our full hookup RV sites, Apollo Lodge is built for highway travelers, long-term contractors, families, and truckers - directly off I-45 in Fairfield, TX. Rooms are cleaned daily and stocked with the essentials. King, Queen, and 2-Queen bed configurations - every room includes the same core amenities regardless of type. Shared amenities available to all hotel and RV park guests throughout the property. Ample lot space for 18-wheelers, work trucks, trailers, and oversized vehicles - directly on the I-45 frontage road. Pull straight in, no garage
